title: Report suspected odometer tampering
summary: Report suspected odometer tampering to NSW Fair Trading if you believe an odometer reading has been illegally interfered with.
intro:
It's an offence in NSW to interfere with an odometer reading, and the Motor Dealers and Repairers Act 2013 deems interference to be:

If you suspect an odometer has been tampered with, you can report the matter to NSW Fair Trading. If they find that the law has been broken, they'll inform the trader and take the action required to protect other consumers.
who_can_apply: You have not already reported the matter.
The suspect odometer reading is not being reviewed by a court or tribunal.
what_you_need: Details of the business/seller of the vehicle
Any supporting documents, such as receipts, invoices, and/or contracts for the vehicle

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete the online report form.

more_info.text: Odometer interference can result in very severe penalties, and an offending motor dealer or repairer may also be liable to pay the losses of a purchaser through civil action.
